rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is subject to a definite cap or restriction.

example.english: The amount each person can take is limited.
example.jyutping: mui5 jan4 ho2 lo2 ge3 sou3 loeng6 jau5 haan6

rows.note: Use this colloquial expression when the emphasis is that the quantity or number is small.

example.english: The cash I have on hand is limited.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sau2 tau4 soeng6 ge3 jin6 gam1 m4 do1
